reading.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006, headquartered in Redwood City, and operating under the parent entity Learneo, Inc., with one AI-associated product on record: QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool.

The single product tracked here sits in the writing and editing category. Paraphrasing tools of this kind are computationally modest compared to foundation model inference, relying on relatively lightweight text transformation rather than large-scale generative workloads. The data does not include model details, inference volume, or infrastructure arrangements, so no claim about compute demand or power draw is supportable from it.

What the data covers is narrow: a company identity, a founding date, a location, and one product association. It does not cover use cases, customer scale, or any other products Course Hero or Learneo may operate. A reader looking for a fuller picture of Learneo's AI footprint would need entries beyond this one.

profile_text.body:
Course Hero is an online learning platform founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. It operates as a business of Learneo, Inc. and describes itself as offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. The site presents itself as a tool for students to get academic help across a wide range of subjects and course types.

The held facts for Course Hero include the AI-assisted writing and paraphrasing tool QuillBot, listed under the writing and editing category, which is associated with the Course Hero website. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the held data.
